title: Final: pitfalls
sub: Find the bug in each snippet
cards/0/explain: InsertAsync without await: the inserts start all at once on one _db (that's a race), the commit runs before they finish, and their errors land in tasks nobody awaits.
cards/1/explain: CS1996: lock is a Monitor, and only the owner thread can release it, while after await another thread may continue the method. You need SemaphoreSlim: await WaitAsync before the try, Release in the finally.
cards/2/q: A TaskCompletionSource is completed from a library callback while the library holds its internal lock. What do you do so the waiters' code doesn't run under that lock?
cards/2/options/1: Have the waiters write await tcs.Task.ConfigureAwait(false)
cards/2/options/2: Nothing: continuations go to the pool anyway
cards/2/explain: With the flag, the waiters' continuations are queued, and SetResult immediately returns control to the library.
cards/2/wrong/1: The opposite: with no context, the continuation is all the more certain to run right inside SetResult.
cards/2/wrong/2: Without the flag and without a context, the continuation runs synchronously inside SetResult: on the library's thread, under its lock.
cards/3/q: A Channel pipeline: the producer wrote every item and returned, the consumers processed everything, but await Task.WhenAll(consumers) never completes. What's missing?
cards/3/options/2: An unbounded channel instead of CreateBounded
cards/3/explain: To a reader, an empty channel that isn't completed means "wait for the next one". await foreach over ReadAllAsync exits only when the channel is completed and empty. Complete goes in the producer's finally.
cards/4/q: How can you limit the number of concurrent requests? Select all that apply.
cards/4/options/1: SemaphoreSlim(N, N) and await WaitAsync before each request
cards/4/options/2: A bounded Channel and N consumers
cards/4/explain: WhenAll limits nothing: it waits for whatever it's given. The other three keep no more than N requests running.
cards/5/q: _gate = new SemaphoreSlim(1, 1). SaveAsync, holding _gate, calls ValidateAsync, which also does await _gate.WaitAsync(). What happens?
cards/5/options/0: It hangs forever: the semaphore has no owner, and ValidateAsync waits for the slot SaveAsync holds
cards/5/options/1: It goes through: the call comes from the same chain, and the semaphore can see that
cards/5/options/2: SynchronizationLockException: another method took the slot
cards/5/explain: A semaphore counts slots, not owners. Entering again is a silent deadlock: the Release in SaveAsync won't run until ValidateAsync completes, and ValidateAsync is waiting for that Release.
cards/5/wrong/1: That's how the reentrant Monitor behaves. SemaphoreSlim doesn't know who took a slot.
cards/5/wrong/2: SynchronizationLockException is what Monitor.Exit throws on a thread that isn't the owner. A semaphore has no owner, so there's nothing to check.
cards/6/explain: await using calls DisposeAsync in a finally and waits for it without blocking the thread.
cards/7/q: Make the token from WithCancellation reach the generator
cards/7/explain: WithCancellation hands the token to GetAsyncEnumerator, and the generated enumerator puts it into the parameter marked [EnumeratorCancellation]. Without the attribute you get warning CS8425 and cancellation that silently doesn't work.
cards/8/q: A generator reads a huge file with await foreach and yield return, and the consumer spends a second on each line. How many lines does the generator read ahead?
cards/8/options/0: None: it stays parked at yield return until the consumer asks for the next line
cards/8/options/1: The whole file: the generator reads in the background while the consumer is busy
cards/8/options/2: As many as fit in the IAsyncEnumerable's buffer
cards/8/explain: The generator runs only inside MoveNextAsync. While the consumer processes a line, the next MoveNextAsync hasn't been called, and the generator stays put. Memory holds one line, not the file (the file stream inside keeps only a small byte buffer).
cards/9/pairs/2/1: Complete a TaskCompletionSource task if it isn't complete yet
cards/9/pairs/5/1: The token from WithCancellation has nowhere to go
